scope.symbolic: Six full-caller init/update SAT witnesses require both transfer slots active and all representation/identity premises. Parsed per-slot validation plus reviewed executor result semantics and actual audited writable metas establish managed-data byte preservation at every emitted executor call, for arbitrary before/replacement bytes under a writable-key CPI frame. Full256-bit keys share identity and byte values; distinct program identities, stable metadata and native objects/local buffers remain assumed. Arbitrary before-data supports repeated-step composition but this is not a complete dynamic CPI or native-memory theorem.
scope.frame_control: Negative control: an overbroad managed-account write frame must fail byte-preservation. scope.native: Native ASan/UBSan executions of instrumented emitted ABI2 adapters with actual token validator/executor, codecs and root. Syscalls are stubbed; arbitrary token balance/delegate writes and failures exercise pending buffer isolation and delayed managed-state commit. No SPL semantics, VM frame enforcement or transaction rollback claim.

executorAudit.scope: Exact full-body token conformance, not semantic preservation. Conditional index/read/loop facts are checked separately against the parsed validator.
